errors.coursesCourseNotFound: There is no such course — check the folder under content/course/.
errors.coursesLocked: This lesson has not opened yet.
errors.coursesShapeForbidsSubmission: This course does not take hand-ins.
errors.coursesSubmissionEmpty: Write something before you send it.
errors.coursesAlreadyReplied: This hand-in has already been answered — it cannot be changed now.
errors.coursesContentRowLocked: This row comes from a content file ({file}) and is not edited here. Change it there and run `node run.mjs content-apply`.
errors.coursesSlugClaimedByContent: The slug “{slug}” belongs to the content file {file} — even if it has never been applied. Pick another one, or change it in the file.
errors.coursesSlugTaken: Another row already holds the slug “{slug}”. A slug is an address — there are no two the same.
errors.coursesSlugMalformed: “{slug}” is not a slug: lower-case ASCII letters, digits and single hyphens.
errors.coursesPositionTaken: Position {position} is already taken here. A row from a content file holds its position too.
errors.coursesBlockNotEmpty: This block still holds {count, plural, one {one lesson} other {# lessons}}. Delete those first — a click does not take them with it.
errors.coursesUploadTooLarge: This file is larger than {max}, and that is all this slot takes. Pick a smaller one.
errors.coursesSlotNotAttachable: This slot takes {types} — this file is something else.
errors.coursesUploadTicketMismatch: This upload was not created for this course and is not accepted here. Choose the file again in the video field.
errors.coursesReplyEmpty: A reply with no text cannot be saved. Leave the hand-in open instead.
errors.coursesReplyTooLong: This reply is too long. At most {max, number} characters.
errors.coursesUnitTextTooLong: That text is too long for one lesson. Shorten it, or split the lesson.

courses.title: Course
courses.listIntro: What is on offer here — and what you are already working through.
courses.listEmptyTitle: This environment holds no course yet
courses.listEmptyBody: A course is a folder under content/course/, and `node run.mjs content-apply` brings it into this environment. Rows do not travel with a deploy — that is what the file is for.
courses.accountExportNote: Your download contains which lessons you completed and what you handed in, together with the answer you were given.
courses.accountDeletionNote: Deleting your account removes everything from the course: your progress, your hand-ins and the replies to them.
courses.brokenTitle: The course is switched on, but its settings do not add up
courses.brokenIntro: While that is so, the course answers "not found" for everyone. This is what config/course.json says:
courses.emptyTitle: There is no course here yet
courses.emptyBody: The blocks and lessons live in content/course/*.json and reach this environment with `node run.mjs content-apply`. Rows do not travel with a deploy.
courses.blockPaused: Opens once your access is running again
courses.lessonNextLocked: The next lesson has not opened yet.
courses.taskHint: At most {max, number} characters. You can revise it until somebody has answered.
courses.submissionArrivedBody: Your hand-in of {date} is here and will be read. The answer appears on this page.
courses.submissionFrozen: This hand-in has been answered — the text stays as it is now, because the answer refers to it.

coursesAdmin.title: Course structure
coursesAdmin.noCourseTitle: This environment holds no course yet
coursesAdmin.noCourseBody: A course is a folder under content/course/ with a course.json in it. `node run.mjs content-apply` brings it into this environment.
coursesAdmin.description: {blocks, plural, =0 {No block yet} one {One block} other {# blocks}}, {lessons, plural, =0 {no lesson} one {one lesson} other {# lessons}} — what this environment holds of the course.
coursesAdmin.environmentTitle: What is here is only here
coursesAdmin.environmentBody: This page shows the rows in the database of the "{environment}" environment. A deploy carries code, not rows: whatever was created here exists in no other environment. Anything that should be everywhere belongs in content/course/*.json and reaches every environment with `node run.mjs content-apply`.
coursesAdmin.brokenTitle: The course is switched on, but its settings do not add up
coursesAdmin.brokenIntro: While that is so, the course answers "not found" for your members, and there is nothing to see here. This is what config/course.json says:
coursesAdmin.unreadableTitle: A content file cannot be read
coursesAdmin.unreadableBody: These files under content/course/ are not a valid JSON block: {files}. While that is so, `node run.mjs content-apply` refuses the whole run — and the rows from those files appear below as "file no longer in the tree".
coursesAdmin.emptyTitle: This environment holds no course yet
coursesAdmin.emptyBody: A block is a file under content/course/, and `node run.mjs content-apply` brings it into this environment. Rows do not travel with a deploy — which is what the file is for.
coursesAdmin.blockEmpty: This block holds no lesson yet.
coursesAdmin.releaseAfterDays: {days, plural, =0 {open from the start} one {opens after one day} other {opens after # days}}
coursesAdmin.originContentOrphan: file no longer in the tree
coursesAdmin.createBlockDescription: This block comes into being in this environment only. Anything that should be everywhere belongs in content/course/*.json.
coursesAdmin.createUnitDescription: This lesson exists here only. Its slug is its address and its Subject Key at once, and cannot be changed later.
coursesAdmin.moveDescription: The order is a number. A position held by a row from a content file is taken.
coursesAdmin.deleteBlockBody: The block disappears from this environment. If it still holds lessons the delete is refused — remove those first.
coursesAdmin.deleteUnitBody: The lesson disappears from this environment. Your members' completions and hand-ins hang on its slug and stay.
coursesAdmin.fieldSlugHint: Lower-case letters, digits, hyphens. It becomes part of the address and cannot be changed afterwards.
coursesAdmin.fieldReleaseAfterDaysHint: Counted from each member's own purchase, never from a date. 0 means open from the start.
coursesAdmin.fieldTaskPromptHint: Anything here makes the lesson ask for a hand-in.
coursesAdmin.lockedHint: From a file — not editable here
coursesAdmin.mediaDescription: {filled, plural, =0 {Nothing is attached to this lesson yet.} one {One file is attached to this lesson.} other {# files are attached to this lesson.}} Who may see them is decided by the server: they belong to the course and are delivered only to members holding its plan.
coursesAdmin.mediaLockedTitle: This lesson comes from a content file
coursesAdmin.mediaLockedBody: Its files are named as a PATH in {file} and reach this environment through `node run.mjs content-apply`. They cannot be attached here — the next run would overwrite the assignment without a word.
coursesAdmin.slotDetachBody: The connection goes, the file itself stays in storage — it may still hang on another lesson. Getting it back is not something this page can do, though: you would upload it again.
coursesAdmin.slotTooLarge: The file you picked is {size}, and at most {max} gets through here.
coursesAdmin.slotUploadReady: The file has arrived and is attached to this lesson.
coursesAdmin.slotUploadTransportFailed: The file did not reach storage. Check your connection and pick it again.
coursesAdmin.slotAttached: {slot} is now attached to this lesson.
coursesAdmin.submissionsDescription: What your learners have handed in — oldest first, so nobody waits.
coursesAdmin.submissionsWaitingMore: Showing the {shown, number} oldest of {total, number}.
coursesAdmin.submissionsAnsweredHint: The last {limit, number}. This is not an archive and not a search.
coursesAdmin.submissionsEmptyBody: Every hand-in has been answered. New ones appear here by themselves.
coursesAdmin.submissionsAnsweredEmptyBody: Once you have replied to a hand-in it will be listed here.
coursesAdmin.submissionOpenMember: Open this member in user administration
coursesAdmin.submissionReplyHint: At most {max, number} characters. Once it is sent the hand-in can no longer be revised.
coursesAdmin.submissionSendBody: After this the hand-in is frozen for the member — they can no longer revise their text.
coursesAdmin.submissionRewriteBody: The previous text is replaced. There is no version history, and the member sees only the new reply.
coursesAdmin.digestSubject: {count, plural, one {One hand-in is waiting for an answer} other {# hand-ins are waiting for an answer}}
coursesAdmin.digestHeading: {count, plural, one {One hand-in is waiting} other {# hand-ins are waiting}}
coursesAdmin.digestBody: {count, plural, one {One hand-in in your course is waiting to be read and answered.} other {# hand-ins in your course are waiting to be read and answered.}} This mail deliberately names nobody — who handed in what is in the app.
